newsitem.title: USA: U.S. stocks seen mixed to higher in early trade.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stocks seen mixed to higher in early trade.

text.p: Wall Street stocks were expected to open mixed-to-higher on Monday after last week's bout of profit-taking, analysts said.
But they added that profit-taking could resume after the opening as investors played safe ahead of this week's first piece of improtant eceonomic data -- Tuesday's fourth quarter employee cost index.
"The futures are a bit higher, so I imagine at least the Dow will open on the upside after getting beat up for three sessions," said Prudential Securities analyst Larry Wachtel.
